- Text content should appear first on mobile
- Visual can appear below as supporting element
- Main message and CTAs are immediately visible

**Location:**

- Section: .hero-container grid layout

**Technical approach:**
- Adjust CSS media query for mobile
- Consider using 'order' property or restructuring the grid
- Ensure text content takes priority on small screens

title: Optimize font loading - consolidate @import to BaseLayout.astro only
description:
Currently, every component has its own Google Fonts @import statement, causing the fonts to be loaded multiple times. This is inefficient and impacts page load performance.

**Current state:**
- DentistHero.astro has @import
- Services.astro has @import
- About.astro has @import
- Testimonials.astro has @import
- CTA.astro has @import
- Footer.astro has @import

**Desired state:**
- Single @import in BaseLayout.astro (or index.astro global styles)
- Remove @import from all individual components
- Fonts still work consistently across all components

**Technical approach:**
1. Add @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&display=swap') to BaseLayout.astro or index.astro global styles
2. Remove @import from all 6 component files
3. Verify fonts still render correctly

**Benefits:**
- Faster page load (fonts loaded once, not 6 times)
- Reduced network requests
- Better performance scores
- Cleaner component code

title: Investigate astro build EPERM
description: Track down Vite/Astro build failure: [@astro/plugin-build-pages] spawn EPERM when loading @astro-page for src/pages/index. Determine cause and fix or document workaround.
notes: Reproduced: any Node child_process.exec/spawn fails with EPERM in this environment (node -e exec('net use') and exec('cmd /c echo hi') both fail). Vite calls exec('net use') in optimizeSafeRealPathSync on Windows, which triggers the Astro build error. Workaround: run build outside this sandbox or in an environment where Node can spawn child processes; otherwise Vite would need a patch to skip the net-use check.
